title: The Martian Won a Golden Globe for Comedy. Why?
topic: The Globes split films into Drama and Musical or Comedy; The Martian won Best Musical or Comedy in 2016, the Globes then banned 'dramas with comedic overtones', and Get Out was still entered as a comedy two years later.

twist: The Globes split films into Drama and Musical or Comedy; The Martian won Best Musical or Comedy in 2016, the Globes then banned 'dramas with comedic overtones', and Get Out was still entered as a comedy two years later.
